description: Reviewed pages hosted elsewhere that may use the service from the browser (CORS), each by its exact https origin. Such a page reaches the player only in browsers with Local Network Access, after the user allows local network access, and changes still need the serial number. Policy as data: a page is added or removed with a card catalog, never an image. Without this file only the page on the card uses the service.

github_pages_prototype.purpose: The Disc Player prototype on GitHub Pages (2026-09-30). Every project site of the account shares this origin; a site of its own replaces it before any wider use.
